content: Hi! How can I help you with your files or class notes today?
Hey! I'm trying to access the lecture notes you shared, but I'm not sure if I can actually download them.

Absolutely, I'm glad you reached out! I set up a view-only link for privacy, if you need to download any files, just click the three dots next to each note and select 'Download.' You can browse all the PDFs in the shared folder here: <class_notes_link>.
Thanks! I see the notes now. Is it okay if I share the link with my study group, or do you want to keep it private?

I appreciate you checking, that's thoughtful! For everyone's privacy, let's ask before sharing. If your group needs access, I can set up a temporary link that expires after a week. Let me know what works best.
A week should be perfect. Also, I noticed some diagrams are missing from Lecture 4. Did the upload get interrupted?
Good catch! Sometimes uploads stall with big images. I'll re-upload the Lecture 4 diagrams in the same folder, refresh the page in a minute and they should appear. Feel free to browse while you wait.
They're there now! Could I grab the original files for the diagrams? The view quality is a little low.
Of course! Click 'Download Original' under each diagram for the best quality. If you need everything at once, there's a ZIP option at the top of the folder for easy downloading.
That helps a lot. Should I organize these into subfolders, or just leave them as is?

Organizing by lecture or topic keeps things tidy, but it's up to you! If you'd like, I can add folders for each week, just let me know your preference. Meanwhile, feel free to click around and rearrange as you see fit.
Folders for each week would be awesome. Thanks for making this so easy!
Happy to help! I'll set up weekly folders now. If you ever want to adjust sharing permissions or see who has access, visit the folder settings page. Let me know if anything else comes up!
Will do! Everything's working perfectly now.
That's great to hear. Enjoy the notes and good luck with your studies, reach out anytime if you need more files or sharing tweaks!
